beats.care: Plan early pandal visits with an umbrella. Forecasters don't expect widespread or nonstop rain.
beats.what: IMD forecasts light rain at a few places on Chaturthi (Oct 14), then light to moderate rain on Panchami (Oct 15). Gusty winds are possible.
beats.why: A low-pressure area over the Bay of Bengal is pushing moisture towards south Bengal.

cards.body: Alipore weather office says Shashthi (Oct 16) may bring thunderstorms with 40–50 km/h gusts, but no heavy, continuous rain.
Only light rain at a few spots in South 24 Parganas and East Midnapore by then.
cards.caption: When it should dry out

cards.body: The late Puja days — Ashtami to Dashami — currently look mostly dry.

cards.q: Rain or not, are you pandal-hopping?
Which Puja days have the highest rain risk?
cards.why: IMD's forecast shows rain peaking Oct 15–16, easing from Oct 18.

learn.t: A low-pressure area over the southeast Bay of Bengal is behind the Puja-week rain, forecasters say.

watch: Rain risk is highest Oct 15–16; most of south Bengal should dry out from October 18.
